ex.en: A small car is more economical than a large one.
ex.zh: 小車比大車省錢。

ex.en: This car is very economical on gas.
ex.zh: 這輛車很省油。

ex.en: Buying in bulk is more economical.
ex.zh: 大量購買比較划算。

economical.en: not costing much money to use or buy

ex.en: Many economists are ignorant of that fact.
ex.zh: 很多經濟學家都不知道這件事。

ex.en: Economists expect the economy to grow next year.
ex.zh: 經濟學家預期明年經濟會成長。

economist.en: a person who studies how money, trade and industry work

ex.en: We need to economize on electricity.
ex.zh: 我們需要節省用電。

ex.en: Many families are economizing by cooking at home.
ex.zh: 很多家庭靠在家煮飯來省錢。

economize.en: to spend less money or use less of something

ex.en: More and more women have their own careers and are economically independent of their husbands.
ex.zh: 越來越多女性擁有自己的事業，在經濟上不必依賴丈夫。

ex.en: The region has grown economically since the new factory opened.
ex.zh: 新工廠設立後，這個地區在經濟上持續成長。

economically.en: in a way that relates to money and trade

ex.en: We need to use our resources more economically.
ex.zh: 我們需要更節省地使用資源。

ex.en: You can travel economically if you book early.
ex.zh: 提早訂票的話，旅行可以省很多錢。

economically.en: in a way that saves money or resources

ex.en: We heard the echo of our voices from the other side of the valley.
ex.zh: 我們聽見自己的聲音從山谷另一頭傳了回來。

ex.en: There's an echo in this empty room.
ex.zh: 這個空房間裡有回音。

echo.en: a sound that you hear again when it hits a wall or hill

ex.en: Ziri heard the sound of a motorcycle echoing in the valley.
ex.zh: 齊里聽到摩托車的聲音在山谷間迴盪。

ex.en: Her footsteps echoed down the hall.
ex.zh: 她的腳步聲在走廊上迴盪。

echo.en: to be heard again after hitting a surface

ex.en: The manager echoed the CEO's comments.
ex.zh: 經理附和了執行長的說法。

ex.en: Many customers echoed the same complaint.
ex.zh: 許多顧客也提出了同樣的抱怨。

echo.en: to say or express the same idea as someone else

ex.en: Which is more important, economic development or environmental protection?
ex.zh: 發展經濟和保護環境，哪一個比較重要？

ex.en: Algeria is in the midst of an economic crisis.
ex.zh: 阿爾及利亞正處於經濟危機之中。

ex.en: The economic outlook for next year is positive.
ex.zh: 明年的經濟前景看好。

economic.en: relating to money, trade and industry

ex.en: The ecological footprint of a country is closely related to its level of economic development.
ex.zh: 一個國家的生態足跡與其經濟發展程度密切相關。

ex.en: The oil spill caused an ecological disaster.
ex.zh: 漏油事件造成了生態浩劫。

ex.en: We must protect the ecological balance of the wetlands.
ex.zh: 我們必須保護濕地的生態平衡。

ecological.en: relating to plants, animals and their natural surroundings

ex.en: Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
ex.zh: 汙染會對一個地區的生態造成極大的影響。

ex.en: Tourism is damaging the island's ecology.
ex.zh: 觀光正在破壞島上的生態。

ecology.en: the relationship between living things and their surroundings

ex.en: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
ex.zh: 她是受到他的影響，才開始對生態學感興趣。

ex.en: She is studying marine ecology at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學研讀海洋生態學。

ecology.en: the study of living things and their surroundings

ex.en: Pollution is damaging the ocean's ecosystem.
ex.zh: 污染正在破壞海洋生態系。

ex.en: Bees play an important role in the ecosystem.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂在生態系中扮演重要角色。

ecosystem.en: all the living things in an area and how they live together with their surroundings

ex.en: An eclipse of the moon is a rare phenomenon.
ex.zh: 月食是一種罕見的現象。

ex.en: Did you see the eclipse yesterday?
ex.zh: 你看了昨天的月蝕了嗎？

ex.en: Did you see yesterday's total lunar eclipse?
ex.zh: 你看到昨天的日全食了嗎？

eclipse.en: an event when the sun or moon is hidden by another body in space

ex.en: Her talent eclipsed that of all the other singers.
ex.zh: 她的才華使所有其他歌手黯然失色。

ex.en: The moon eclipsed the sun for a few minutes.
ex.zh: 月亮遮住了太陽幾分鐘。

eclipse.en: to be so good that others seem less important

eclectic.zh: 不拘一格的、兼收並蓄的

ex.en: She has an eclectic taste in music, from jazz to folk.
ex.zh: 她的音樂品味兼容並蓄，從爵士到民謠都聽。

ex.en: The shop sells an eclectic mix of old and new furniture.
ex.zh: 這家店賣的新舊家具風格混搭、不拘一格。

eclectic.en: using many different styles or sources

ex.en: Our eccentric neighbor wears a hat even when he sleeps.
ex.zh: 我們那位古怪的鄰居連睡覺都戴著帽子。

ex.en: People thought she was eccentric, but she was simply creative.
ex.zh: 大家覺得她很古怪，但她其實只是很有創意。

eccentric.en: behaving in a strange way that is different from most people

ex.en: My mother is eccentric.
ex.zh: 我媽媽是個怪人。

ex.en: The old man was a harmless eccentric who talked to his plants.
ex.zh: 那位老先生是個無害的怪人，會跟他的植物說話。

eccentric.en: a person who behaves in a strange way

ex.en: A stable economy is the aim of every government.
ex.zh: 穩定的經濟是每個政府的目標。

ex.en: He contributed much to the development of the economy.
ex.zh: 他對經濟發展貢獻良多。

ex.en: It will also help to strengthen the city's economy.
ex.zh: 這也有助於強化城市的經濟。

economy.en: the system of money, trade and industry in a country

ex.en: We flew economy class to save money.
ex.zh: 為了省錢，我們搭經濟艙。

ex.en: Economy class was full, so we upgraded.
ex.zh: 經濟艙客滿了，所以我們升等了。

economy.en: the cheapest kind of seat on a plane

ex.en: We always fly economy class to save money.
ex.zh: 為了省錢，我們都搭經濟艙。

ex.en: Economy class seats were all sold out.
ex.zh: 經濟艙的座位全賣完了。

economy class.en: the cheapest kind of seat on a plane

ex.en: She studied economics at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學主修經濟學。

ex.en: Economics helps us understand how markets work.
ex.zh: 經濟學幫助我們了解市場如何運作。

ex.en: He teaches economics at a high school.
ex.zh: 他在一所高中教經濟學。

ex.en: The old building was once used for ecclesiastical meetings.
ex.zh: 這棟老建築曾用來舉行教會會議。

ex.en: He studied ecclesiastical history at university.
ex.zh: 他在大學主修教會史。

ex.en: The children screamed in ecstasy when they saw the snow.
ex.zh: 孩子們看到雪時欣喜若狂地尖叫。

ex.en: She danced around the room in pure ecstasy.
ex.zh: 她在房間裡欣喜若狂地跳舞。

ex.en: She was ecstatic when she heard she had passed the exam.
ex.zh: 她聽到自己通過考試時欣喜若狂。

ex.en: The fans were ecstatic after their team won the final.
ex.zh: 球隊贏得決賽後，球迷都欣喜若狂。

ex.en: He gave me an ecstatic hug at the airport.
ex.zh: 他在機場給了我一個欣喜若狂的擁抱。

ex.en: The ecologist studied how pollution affects the river.
ex.zh: 這位生態學家研究汙染如何影響這條河。

ex.en: An ecologist explained why wetlands are important.
ex.zh: 一位生態學家解釋了濕地為何重要。

ecumenical.zh: 普世基督教的；跨教派的

ex.en: Leaders from many churches attended the ecumenical service.
ex.zh: 許多教會的領袖出席了這場跨教派的禮拜。

ex.en: The ecumenical movement aims to bring Christian groups closer together.
ex.zh: 普世教會運動的目標是讓各基督教團體更加團結。

ex.en: Ecuador is a country in South America.
ex.zh: 厄瓜多是南美洲的一個國家。

ex.en: The equator passes through Ecuador, which gave the country its name.
ex.zh: 赤道穿過厄瓜多，國名也因此而來。

ex.en: This farm is run in an ecologically friendly way.
ex.zh: 這座農場以對生態友善的方式經營。

ex.en: The wetlands are ecologically important for migrating birds.
ex.zh: 從生態角度來看，這片濕地對候鳥很重要。

ex.en: Her eccentricity made her the most interesting person in town.
ex.zh: 她的古怪讓她成為鎮上最有趣的人。

ex.en: He is known for the eccentricity of wearing a hat indoors.
ex.zh: 他以在室內戴帽子的怪癖聞名。

ex.en: He rose to the upper echelons of the company.
ex.zh: 他升到了公司的高階層。

ex.en: Only the top echelon of managers attended the meeting.
ex.zh: 只有最高階層的經理參加了會議。

ex.en: The researcher built an econometric model to study housing prices.
ex.zh: 研究人員建立了一個計量經濟模型來研究房價。

ex.en: She took an econometric course using statistics and economics.
ex.zh: 她修了一門結合統計與經濟的計量經濟學課程。

echoing.zh: 發出回音（echo 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Our footsteps were echoing in the empty hall.
ex.zh: 我們的腳步聲在空蕩蕩的大廳裡迴響。

ex.en: Her voice kept echoing through the canyon.
ex.zh: 她的聲音在峽谷裡不斷迴盪。

echoing.zh: 附和；重複（echo 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He kept echoing everything his boss said.
ex.zh: 他不停地重複老闆說的每一句話。

ex.en: Echoing her friend's opinion, she said the idea was great.
ex.zh: 她附和朋友的意見，說這個點子很棒。

ex.en: The bishop spoke about ecclesial unity.
ex.zh: 主教談到了教會的團結。

ex.en: The document was approved by ecclesial authorities.
ex.zh: 這份文件獲得教會當局的核准。

ex.en: Ecotourism brings money to the village without harming the forest.
ex.zh: 生態旅遊為村莊帶來收入，又不會破壞森林。

ex.en: We chose ecotourism for our trip and stayed in a small eco-lodge.
ex.zh: 我們這趟旅行選擇生態旅遊，住在小型生態旅舍。

ex.en: My little brother has eczema on his arms.
ex.zh: 我弟弟的手臂上有濕疹。

ex.en: Cold weather can make eczema worse.
ex.zh: 天氣冷可能讓濕疹更嚴重。
